test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the admin Sales Orders listing at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/ and ultimately opened an order view at /admin/sales_order/view/order_id/533/ — so the base admin URL is set to http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin and the order identifier observed (533) is provided in increment_id to reproduce selecting that order. All other filter fields were not used in the execution and are left empty; open_first_match is true because the agent opened the first matching order view (order_id 533).
